known_information: The live issue body states: Using PowerToys release v0.31.2, some app windows return to their last known zone regardless of whether the PowerToys setting "Move newly created windows to their last known zone" is enabled, presumably because of how they were written. Other apps never return to their last known zone, regardless of this setting. An example of the latter is PowerToys itself. Here’s a screenshot of PowerToys manually put into a zone by “Shift-dragging” it: ![1-Window Manually Put into a Zone](https://user-images..

Please provide: 1) the exact PowerToys version and install channel plus numbered reproduction steps and expected versus actual behavior; and 2) comment /bugreport immediately after reproducing, before restarting PowerToys, so the diagnostic state can distinguish the affected component.
